text:
Dina Lopez (CS): Quick capture from CedarLane onboarding call — forwarding feature asks and risks for triage.
Marcus Wu (PM): paste raw bullets pls
Dina Lopez (CS): Raw: 
- Feature: per-tenant A/B flags in Console so customers can route a percent of traffic to a trial model variant.
- Feature: evaluation dashboard that shows side-by-side quality metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-sim) per-model for a tenant, with direct links to sample prompts.
- Ask: fine-grained billing breakdown by flag (so they can charge internal teams running experiments).
- Pain: renewal concern — procurement wants an "experimentability" clause verified (can we show no-regression runs?).
- Ops ask: warm-start suggestion for tiny test cohorts to avoid noisy tails during A/B tests.
Anika Rao (Eng): Quick thoughts: A/B flags -> routing-layer percent rollout + flag in request metadata. Backend work ~6 dev-days, UI ~3. Eval dashboard -> needs eval infra + consistent prompt set per-tenant ~2w infra + 1w frontend. Billing by-flag -> extend exporter to include flag label ~2 dev-days. Warm-start -> small per-flag warm pool maybe 5 dev-days infra.
Becca Stern (Product): Prioritization from CedarLane: billing by-flag + experiment dashboard = renewal critical. A/B flags nice-to-have but tied to dashboard.
Marcus Wu (PM): Proposed triage:
1) Billing breakdown by-flag & CSV export -> P0 -> owner: Marcus Wu -> ETA: 2w -> reason: finance/renewal
2) Tenant eval dashboard (sample prompts + metrics) -> P0 -> owner: Becca Stern -> ETA: 3w -> reason: procurement needs evidence of regressions/no-regressions
3) A/B percent flags in Console -> P1 -> owner: Anika Rao -> ETA: 4w -> reason: enables experiments
4) Warm-start per-flag pilot -> P1 -> owner: Anika Rao -> ETA: 2w pilot
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-8120: "CedarLane billing-by-flag + eval dashboard" assigned to Marcus Wu due 2w
Dina Lopez (CS): Please include acceptance criteria: CSV columns = date, tenant_id, flag, route, token_count, cost_cents, currency. Eval dashboard acceptance: tenant can run a 50-sample smoke eval and see pass/fail and diffs.
Anika Rao (Eng): Will scope infra changes after we get sample prompt set and one-week trace of traffic.
Marcus Wu (PM): I'll draft PRD + attach example prompt set. ETA Fri.
Becca Stern (Product): I'll mock dashboard wireframes and RBAC options by Wed.
Dina Lopez (CS): Scheduling customer follow-up for demo of proposed dashboard next Tue 2pm. Will upload call recording and sample prompts to /customers/cedarlane/onboard. :thumbsup:
Marcus Wu (PM): Thanks team — I'll update CS-8120 when PRD lands. :rocket:
